The Materials and Process Engineer II designs experiments and pathfinder hardware, characterizes materials through mechanical, thermal, chemical, and microstructural testing, and uses statistics to define robust process windows. Materials and Process Engineers are a vital part of helping Varda build flight hardware consistently and at increasing cadence. jobs.description_text: About this Role We are seeking a highly talented, self-motivated Senior Spacecraft Astrodynamics Engineer (you may also know this as mission design, trajectory design or flight dynamics) to join our rapidly growing startup. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Access Management
jobs.description_text: The Opportunity Every day, a security administrator somewhere decides who can open which door. A new nurse starts on Monday and needs the medication room but not the server closet. A contractor needs the loading dock for three weeks. Someone leaves the company at 5pm and their badge should stop working at 5:01. Multiply that by 200,000 employees across 400 sites, and you have one of the largest and least-solved logistical problems in enterprise software. Access control is Verkada's second largest business: hundreds of millions of dollars in sales, growing 40 to 60% year over year, with roughly 80 people building in this area. Access management is the pillar that decides whether all of that feels effortless or exhausting. We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to own it end to end: users, identities, groups, policies, requests, access levels, and visitor access, from the moment an admin expresses intent to the moment a door opens for the right person. We do this well today. We think it can be dramatically better, through interfaces that make scale feel simple, APIs and integrations that let the system run itself, and agents that let an admin state what they want instead of clicking through configuration. You will own that as a vertical slice: web and mobile, the backend behind them, the configuration we push to door hardware, and the API and agent surfaces we expose. jobs.description_text: The Manager, Shared Services & Process Improvement designs, improves, and documents the processes that run across the People Team, so that work is done once, done the same way, and done in the right place. Working with People Operations, HRIS, Benefits, Leave, and ADA, Employee Relations, Talent, Learning and Development, and the business partners, this role maps how work flows today, recommends what to automate, support with AI, redesign, or stop, and drives approved changes through to adoption. As the first process improvement hire, this role is the prerequisite to a longer-term automation roadmap for the People Team, which maps People Team work to automation, skill-building, AI agents, and eventually fully autonomous processes. It works from a prioritized improvement backlog set with People leadership, defines the service measures that show whether changes are working, and designs the shared services model, including the rotation that gives entry-level team members a path into other People Team roles. The role also directs and develops the Shared Services team as its formal people manager, and coaches the early-career team members who rotate through it.
